source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Tees are hard to see on the photo; tee spots are placed from the card's lengths. The order now follows the GolfLogix hole descriptions, which differ from the old guess: 3 now ends at the west-side green north of the old 3 green, and 7 ends at the old 3 green (the description's pond on 7's left only fits that way).
unsure.5: tee placed at the north-east end of the narrow strip, behind a clump of trees; the shot plays over or past those trees
unsure.7: description calls it a soft S (bow left then back right); the photo strip curves gently right toward the green
unsure.8: tee placed at the south end of the long tee strip that 3 also uses; 8's own tee is not clear on the photo
unsure.9: tee placed just south of the 8 green to fit the card's 409 yd; traced 395 yd
